nisha: Hey folks, baby arrived a bit early so I'm shifting my parental leave up by 8 days. We need to cover a 2-week spike in on-call + bug triage. Any quick options besides hiring a contractor?

omar: Congrats! Options: 1) Emergency Family Support reimbursement (up to $1k/mo) for childcare costs, 2) Short-Term Backfill Loan (interest-free up to $5k) for hiring temps.

kelly: For a 2-week contractor (~$1.8k) I'd recommend the STB Loan so payroll can spread repayments. Manager needs to email people-ops with dates, estimated cost, and a short handoff doc.

nisha: Is there any faster route if manager is OOO? Can lead approve?

omar: Manager signoff is required. If they're OOO, their backup can sign but include an attached note from the manager when they return. We can expedite finance review for >$3k cases.

payroll-bot: payroll-bot: After approval, submit signed loan agreement to payroll@redwood.com with code STB-LOAN. Default repayment is 6 months via payroll deductions; early repayment allowed.

kelly: Action items: 1) Lead to send manager signoff + runbook + cost to people-ops. 2) People-ops approves and routes to Finance if needed. 3) On approval, submit loan docs to payroll.

nisha: Thanks — I'll ask my lead to email now and attach the triage runbook. Appreciate the quick help.
